packageRules.description: @types/node must track the Node major we actually run (see .nvmrc and engines.node): newer typings make tsc accept APIs that are missing at runtime, and skipLibCheck hides the mismatch
@storybook/test-runner must track the Storybook major we run: 0.24 and later require Storybook 10, while this repo is on Storybook 9
